name: Amish Shah
summary: Amish Mahendra Shah (born 1977/1978) is an American politician and physician who is the representative-elect from Arizona's 1st congressional district. Previously, he served as a member of the Arizona House of Representatives from the 24th district from 2019 to 2023 and the 5th district from 2023 to 2024. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
